entries.description: every telephone listing that carries its own printed telephone number, read column by column across the page spread (each printed page is divided into several stacked sub-columns; read each sub-column top to bottom, left sub-column before right, left page before right page). each such listing is exactly one item. a branch, sub-office, or separate-residence line printed under a subscriber (marked by a branch/dispatch-office/separate-residence token such as the ones meaning 'branch store', 'dispatch office', or 'separate residence') that carries its own telephone number is its own separate item. skip pure cross-reference lines that carry no telephone number of their own, and skip running page-number and reading-index header marks. transcription rule for every kanji field: copy the characters exactly as printed, keeping traditional printed character forms; when two entries' text is compared for equality, a traditional (kyujitai) character form and its modern (shinjitai) simplified counterpart are to be treated as the same character.

subscriberName.description: only the head name of the listing: the personal name or the business/organization name printed in bold at the very start of the listing, transcribed exactly as printed. do NOT append any text that follows the head name on the same line: exclude a trailing care-of reference (another party's name followed by the single 'care of' character), an occupation or trade descriptor, a shop or proprietor annotation, and any parenthetical note. capture the head name and nothing after it.

exchangeName.description: the telephone-exchange label printed immediately before the digits of the number: a short kanji place-name token (it may be preceded by a small ward or district marker glyph). transcribe the place-name token as printed.

phoneNumber.description: the listing's telephone number as printed, in Arabic-digit NN-NNNN form (two digits, a hyphen, four digits). when a single subscriber prints several numbers grouped by a brace/bracket, record only the topmost number.
